findings: Every listed operation has an existing legacy native producer. Ledger adapter-missing does not mean producer absent.

Data search already delegates to ContextPlane's current per-page server client/mailbox authorization and canonical provenance/coverage; it is the clearest existing authenticated reuse seam, not a completed Meri installation.

Representation, R5 District Nexus and manual tracked-bill native tool methods do not themselves perform actor client-wall authorization. Separate ContextPlane adapters must not be credited to these paths.

Outreach has two different owners: private actor-owned record detail versus tenant campaign rows. Business development requires an owned legacy Clio conversation and saved current prospect scope; native Meri conversation identity is not interchangeable.
Public web performs external provider/live-fetch network work. This mapping makes no recommendation to activate it.
No new routes, private permissions, timing policy, account-assignment model or claim of installed current Meri adapter is proposed.
